name: Silberbergwerk Schwaz
kurzbeschreibung: The historic silver mine in Schwaz takes visitors deep underground on an authentic mine train into the heart of medieval Europe's mining capital.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The historic Silberbergwerk Schwaz in Tyrol's lower Inn Valley is famously known as the "Mother of all Mines" and ranks among Europe's most significant industrial heritage monuments. During the 15th and 16th centuries, Schwaz was the preeminent silver and copper mining centre of the continent, yielding up to 85 percent of the world's silver output. This immense mineral wealth laid the foundation for the rise of the Habsburg dynasty and financed the Fugger banking empire. Today, the show mine provides a captivating subterranean look at the perilous daily work of medieval miners deep inside Mount Falkenstein.

Route & Anforderungen

The adventure begins aboard a narrow-gauge electric mine train that carries visitors 800 metres deep into the mountain along the Sigmund-Ernst gallery. From there, a guided 90-minute walking tour traverses narrow tunnels hand-hewn into solid dolomite rock, vast underground caverns, and massive medieval water wheels. Inside the mine, the temperature remains at a constant 12 degrees Celsius year-round with high humidity. Sturdy walking shoes and warm clothing are essential. Safety helmets and protective capes are provided on arrival. The tour is well-suited for families with children aged 4 and above.

Besuch & Anreise

The silver mine is open daily throughout the year (typically 09:00 to 17:00 in summer, 10:00 to 16:00 in winter). Regular adult admission is roughly 19.00 Euro and 11.00 Euro for children. By car, take the Inntal motorway A12 to the Schwaz exit and follow local signs to the mine car park, where free parking is provided. By train, travel to Schwaz main railway station; local city buses connect directly to the Silberbergwerk bus stop, or you can walk up to the entrance in around 20 minutes.

Tipps

Booking advance online tickets is strongly advised during peak summer holiday periods to avoid queue times. Pair your underground visit with a stroll through Schwaz old town, visiting the Gothic parish church and majestic Fugger merchant residences.
